text:
incident-bot: Alert: spike in 5xx from API gateway (edge -> gw) detected in eu-west-1. Error rate 502/504 up from 0.3% to 9.8% over 3m. Paging oncall. Rule: apigw.gateway.5xx.rate > 5%
Alex M: acked. pulling up dashboards and logs. any recent deploys? :eyes:
Priya G: not from product in last 30m. infra deploy 12:12 UTC to edge-proxy? checking.
Derek S: I'm on the phone but can join in 2 min. tagging edge team. @Edge Team can you confirm?
Edge Team: seeing large fanout to origin from a single client IP range, SYN/handshake delays. TLS renegotiation spikes on a subset of proxies.
Alex M: ok, mitigation plan: 1) enable short circuit to route traffic to gw-failover-eu 2) raise circuit breaker threshold on edge 3) rate-limit top offending CIDR /20 for 10m 4) roll back infra deploy if correlates.
Derek S: agree. start steps 1-3 now. Alex, please run the failover command and post output.
Alex M: running: `rctl failover --region eu-west-1 --target gw-failover-eu`
incident-bot: Command accepted. Failover initiating (id=fov-601234). Streaming logs:
```
[6012345679] initiating route mirror -> gw-failover-eu
[6012345680] draining connections on edge-proxy-9
[6012345685] route switch 40% traffic
```
Alex M: rate limit applied: `rl add 203.0.113.0/20 100rps 600s` output: `ok`
Priya G: circuit breaker thresholds bumped: `cb set apigw-edge 4xx_threshold=20 timeout_ms=2000`
Edge Team: digging into TLS logs — certificate handshake retries from partner-net-42 causing queue head-of-line. They sent retries at ~30rps which amplified on our fanout.
Alex M: good catch. Derek, should we block that partner CIDR temporarily? Customer Ops, do we have a contact?
Customer Ops: we have an account rep (partner-x). Reaching out now, notifying customer impact for eu-west-1 degraded 502/504.
Derek S: let's block for now to stop cascade: `fw block 203.0.113.0/22` and continue to failover. Post the command output.
Alex M: `fw block 203.0.113.0/22` -> applied on edge nodes. Observability: 5xx rate dropped to 2.1% in 90s. latency p95 improved. :thumbsup:
Priya G: rolling back 12:12 infra deploy as precaution — rollback start: `infra rollback edge-proxy:2026-03-15-1212`
incident-bot: Rollback job queued.
Derek S: monitoring customer-facing error rates and SLOs. Begin postmortem stub: INC-601234. Assigning to Alex + Priya.
Alex M: continuing to monitor. setting a 15m watch window. if stable for 15m we'll start gradual restore of normal routing.
Edge Team: internal note — tracing indicates an increase in backend connection timeouts to origin pool A; may be related to origin health checks and retry storms. Create follow-up to review origin circuit limits and backoff.
Customer Ops: partner-x acknowledged unusual retry behavior, they are investigating client library bug.
Alex M: status update: 5xx at 0.9% now. failover keeping heat down. keeping CIDR blocked for 30m.
Priya G: rollback completed, infra verified no regressions.
Derek S: handoff to daytime oncall at +30m. I'll coordinate a bridge for the follow-up with Edge + Product + Customer Ops at 1600 UTC.
Customer Ops: posting external incident update to affected customers: "We detected elevated 5xx errors in eu-west-1 due to partner retry storm; mitigation applied and failover in effect; we're working with the partner to resolve — follow-ups to come."
Alex M: ok closing out immediate page. leaving incident channel open for watch. creating followup tickets: TICKET-APIGW-601234 (postmortem), TICKET-EDGE-601235 (origin backoff review), TICKET-CUST-601236 (customer comms).
Derek S: thanks team. Good containment. If any re-escalation, ping @Derek S directly.
incident-bot: Incident INC-601234 severity=SEV2 -> acknowledged -> status=mitigated (partial).
